# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Instead, report them via the repository's private [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ranajahanzaib/api-backward-compatibility-tester/security/advisories/new) feature. Include as much detail as possible: a description of the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

The project maintainers will review reports and coordinate any necessary fixes privately.
